componentRole.nothingImportsImportsNothing: Nothing imports it, and it imports nothing.
componentRole.bothHighCodebase: {used}, and {uses}. Both are high for this codebase.
componentRole.concreteDependedSoChanges: {coords} Concrete and depended on, so changes here are expensive.
componentRole.abstractnessMatchesHowMuch: {coords} Abstractness matches how much it is depended on.

componentPlotterDiagram.markSeveralGroupsSplit: A mark in several groups is split between their colours.

directoryTree.readEveryFileFolder: Read every file in this folder and group them into topics
directoryTree.noComponentOutsideDirectory: No component outside this directory is depended on.

healthBreakdown.deductionsSumNotRecorded: The deductions sum to {expected}, not the {health} recorded; this snapshot may predate the breakdown's analysis.
healthBreakdown.noCommitsTouchFile: No commits touch this file in the scan, so it has no hotspot.
healthBreakdown.relativeHottestFileSnapshot: relative to the hottest file in this snapshot (
healthBreakdown.hottestFileSnapshotSo: the hottest file in this snapshot, so 100.
healthBreakdown.relativeHottestFileSnapshot2: relative to the hottest file in this snapshot.
healthBreakdown.linesNestingUpLevels: {lines} lines, nesting up to {maxNesting} levels, {avgNesting} on average. {span}
healthBreakdown.snapshotDoesNotRecord: This snapshot does not record how each input counted; scan again to see the deductions.
healthBreakdown.readFromIndentation: No language pack reads this language, so its health is read from its indentation: a rougher reading than the functions a parsed file is scored by.
healthBreakdown.olderFormula: Scored by the formula before revision 11, which deducted for nesting. A new scan scores this file by its functions, imports and size.

metricMatrix.oneRisesOtherFalls: One rises as the other falls (negative ρ)
metricMatrix.belowDiagonalOneMetric: Below the diagonal: one metric against another. On the diagonal: how each metric spreads.
metricMatrix.aboveDiagonalSpearmanS: Above the diagonal: Spearman's rank correlation, deeper the stronger it is.
metricMatrix.tooFewBothReadings: {a} and {b}: too few {noun} with both readings.
metricMatrix.oneFallsOtherRises: , one falls as the other rises
metricMatrix.rankClickPlot: {a} and {b}: {rho}{value} (ρ {value2} by rank, {n} {noun}). Click to plot.
metricMatrix.clickPlotDragBrush: {a} × {b} · click to plot, drag to brush

metricProfiles.oneLinePerCrossing: One line per {grain}, crossing each metric's axis at its reading. Each axis runs from its lowest reading at the bottom to its highest at the top, unless marked flipped; a tick marks its median.
metricProfiles.selectedDrawnOverRest: The selected {value} are drawn over the rest, which recede.

metricSetBar.holdsUpMetricsRemove: {viewName} holds up to {max} metrics; remove one first

metricStrips.oneStripPerMetric: One strip per metric, running from its lowest reading on the left to its highest on the right. Each dot is a {grain}, placed along the strip by its reading.
metricStrips.selectedDrawnOverRest: The selected {value} are drawn over the rest, which recede.

metricsSummary.whatStandsOutSnapshot: What stands out in this snapshot, each with the view that shows it best. These are facts about the numbers; what they mean for your code is yours to judge.
metricsSummary.everyNumberEverySort: Every number for every {o}. Sort, pick columns, export.
metricsSummary.twoMetricsAgainstEach: Two metrics against each other, split at the medians into named corners.
metricsSummary.everyPairMetricsOnce: Every pair of metrics at once, and how strongly each pair moves together.
metricsSummary.eachMetricStripDots: Each metric as a strip of dots. Follow one {o} across all of them; brush to narrow.
metricsSummary.eachOneLineAcross: Each {o} as one line across every metric. Compare shapes; filter on several axes.

rankedRows.moreBrushStripNarrow: and {value} more. Brush a strip to narrow the list.

statSelectSingle.noDescriptionAvailableMetric: No description available for this metric.

usedSurface.unitReferencesNotRecorded: Unit references are not recorded for this language in this snapshot.
usedSurface.unitsUsedOutside: {value} of {value2} units are used from outside.

dirTree.distinctComponentsFileUnder: distinct components with a file under the directory

ranking.onlyNamesContainingComponent: Only names containing this (a component, area or folder).
ranking.onlyThoseMeetingCondition: Only those meeting a condition, e.g. "dependents > 5" or "lines >= 1000 and health < 5".
ranking.notMeasureRankOne: "{measure}" is not a measure: rank by one, such as {value}.
ranking.notMeasureHereMeasures: "{measure}" is not a measure of {among} here. Measures: {value}.
ranking.everyValue0So: Every value is 0, so this ranking says nothing; for history the scanned commit may be old.

summary.usedOtherMedian: {name} is used by {value} other {noun}; the median {one} by {med}.

complexFunctions.whatCognitiveMeans: Cognitive complexity counts each break in a function's flow (if, loop, switch, catch, a run of && or ||) and one more for each level it is nested at. Edits to long functions over 15 were bug fixes about 1.6 times as often as edits to equally long simple ones.
